about: The reviewed decisions for Conflicts of Interest: for each sitting member, whether each organization on their latest reports is interested (lobbies on an issue one of their committees handles, works in an industry their committees oversee, or holds contracts from an agency their committees oversee), and why. Pensions, public employers, the member’s own trusts and foundations, and houses of worship are left out automatically. Read by npm run conflicts:build.
